welcome.title: Welcome to Doppelpad
welcome.text: Doppelpad remaps controllers, keyboard and mouse, with configs of their own for every game. This short guide checks the drivers, finds your controller and makes a first config.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.text: Doppelpad needs ViGEmBus for virtual controllers and HidHide to hide the real controller from games. Both are open and free.
drivers.after: After installing, check again in Settings → Drivers. Keyboard and mouse mappings work without them.

controller.title: Controller
controller.none: No controller found. Connect one over USB or Bluetooth, or play without one, using keyboard and mouse as a controller.

output.title: What should it become?
output.text: Pick a start; everything can be changed later.

finish.title: First config
finish.name: Name of the game
finish.no_pad: No controller connected yet; the config works as soon as one is.

templates.keyboard_mouse: Keyboard and mouse as a controller

template_hints.virtual_xbox: Games see an Xbox 360 controller; your controller is hidden from them. The best start for most games.
template_hints.virtual_ds4: The same as a PlayStation controller, with touchpad and motion reaching the game.
template_hints.desktop: Right stick as the mouse, triggers click, D-pad for the arrow keys; no virtual controller.
template_hints.keyboard_mouse: WASD and the mouse drive a virtual Xbox controller, for games that only know controllers.

sheet.save_title: Save the bindings sheet as HTML
sheet.saved: Bindings sheet saved; open it in a browser to print

profiles.export_title: Save the game with all its configs
profiles.title: Games
profiles.empty: No games yet. Add one to start mapping.
profiles.processes_hint: Programs that switch to this game's config automatically, one per line (e.g. game.exe)
profiles.delete_confirm: Move “{name}” and all its configs to the recycle bin?

header.read_only: Imported file (read-only) — duplicate it to edit
header.clear_confirm: Remove all mappings from this config?
header.delete_confirm: Move the config “{name}” to the recycle bin?
header.no_selection: Select a game on the left or add a new one
header.no_config: This game has no config yet

layers.preset_dropped: {n} layer switches led to layers this config does not have and were removed
layers.inherit_hint_on: Controls this layer does not map do what they do on Main.
layers.inherit_hint_off: Controls this layer does not map do nothing while it is active.
layers.unlock_hint: A keyboard or mouse given back reaches other programs unchanged again, and Main's keyboard or mouse mappings do not apply here. Meant for layers you hold, e.g. to get the real mouse back for a moment.

output.title: Output device
output.hide_physical: Hide the physical controller from games
output.mute_mapped: Block the original keys and buttons that are remapped
output.repress: Re-press held buttons when the layer changes
output.repress_hint: On: held buttons do what they do in the new layer at once. Off: they keep their old action until released.
output.kbm_source_hint: With "from scripts only", programs such as AutoHotkey drive the mappings, for example the virtual controller, while your real keyboard and mouse stay untouched. "Physical devices only" lets injected input pass unchanged.
output.driver_missing: {driver} is not installed — this config cannot be applied yet.
output.hide_missing: HidHide is not installed — games will still see the physical controller.
output.mouse_hint: Held wheel actions repeat at this interval (0: one notch per press). The zones are the physical mouse's speeds (counts per second) for MouseMove controls; the low one is also where its directions start.
output.turns_hint: How the game turns with mouse motion, for flick stick and turn actions: the mouse counts for one full turn, and how long a flick or turn takes.
output.test_turn_hint: Switch to the game within 3 seconds: it should turn exactly once around. Adjust the counts until it does.
output.test_turn_started: Turning in 3 seconds — switch to the game.
output.shake_hint: What a shake action does to the virtual controller's accelerometer. Only controllers with motion sensors (DualShock 4) carry it.
output.timing_hint: Defaults for every mapping of this config; a mapping's own timing wins. Empty fields use the built-in default.

repeat_hint.native: A key that a mapping holds repeats after half a second, about 30 times per second, like a physical keyboard. Only the last pressed key repeats.
repeat_hint.fast: The last held key repeats every 10 ms right away. Some games and text fields fill up quickly.
repeat_hint.slow: The last held key repeats every 50 ms right away.
repeat_hint.off: Each press sends one key-down, however long it is held.
repeat_hint.custom: The last held key repeats at this interval right away.

binding.choose: Click a control on the controller or press it to map it
binding.random_hint: Each cycle waits up to this much longer, at random, so the repeats are less regular.
binding.description_placeholder: What does this do in the game?
binding.jump_postpone: Run the actions at the layer change
binding.jump_postpone_hint: This mapping's actions start only once the delay is over. Let go before that and nothing happens.
binding.gyro_choose: Which way of tilting or turning?
binding.whole_stick_replace: This replaces {n} direction mappings and routes of this stick on this layer. Continue?

whole_stick_keys.wasd: The four directions press W, A, S and D. To change one, pick its direction in the stick's menu.
whole_stick_keys.arrows: The four directions press the arrow keys. To change one, pick its direction in the stick's menu.

binding.whole_stick_none: Choose what the whole stick does on this layer. Its single directions stay in the stick's menu.
binding.whole_stick_inherited: Main's route for this stick works on this layer too. Choose one to replace it here.
binding.whole_stick_clear: Clear this stick on this layer

presets.standard_hint: A gentle curve with some acceleration at the edge; good for most games.
presets.precise_hint: Slow near the centre for fine aiming, quick at the edge.
presets.fast_hint: Linear and quick, with strong acceleration at the edge.
presets.smooth_hint: More smoothing: calmer, with a little delay.

binding.inherited: Inherited from Main — edit to override in this layer
binding.no_layer_mappings: Nothing mapped on this layer yet.

zones.title: Zone
zones.gyro_settings: Gyro zones are set in Analog → Gyro

desc.whole: Active as soon as the control leaves its deadzone, however far it is moved.
desc.low: Active while the control is moved only a little, up to where the medium zone starts.
desc.med: Active in the middle of the range, between the medium and the high threshold.
desc.high: Active while the control is moved far, from the high threshold to the end.
desc.full: Active only while the trigger is pulled all the way, past its full-pull point.

zones.thresholds_hint: Where each zone starts, in % of the full range. Empty fields use the default or split the rest evenly.
zones.shared_stick: Shared by all directions of this stick.
zones.shared_trigger: Shared by all mappings of this trigger.
zones.layer_main: {layer} uses Main's zones; changing them here gives {layer} its own.
zones.err_range: Thresholds must be above 0 % and at most 100 %.
zones.err_order: Low, medium and high must increase.

desc.single: Active for as long as the control is held.
desc.long: Fires once the control has been held for the long-press time, until it is released.
desc.double: Fires on the second quick press and stays active while it is held.
desc.triple: Fires on the third quick press.
desc.start: Fires the moment the control goes down, in addition to the other activators.
desc.release: Fires briefly when the control is released.

vibration.title: Vibration
vibration.hint: How the game's rumble reaches the controller. Rumble that mappings play stays as it is.
vibration.gap_hint: Least time between two rumble commands; the latest value wins.

light.title: Light bar
light.hint: Colour and effect of the DualShock 4 and DualSense light bar, for Main and, if you like, per layer. Without a setting the game sets the colour (virtual DualShock 4).
light.own_layer: Own light bar on this layer
light.cycle: Show the colours one after another

crosshairs.title: Crosshairs
crosshairs.hint: Up to ten crosshairs over the game, in the middle of the primary monitor. Mappings show them with “Show crosshair N”, or they appear while one of their layers is active.
crosshairs.name: Name
crosshairs.mag_size_hint: Diameter relative to the screen height. Windows only.

radial.title: Radial menus
radial.hint: A ring of sectors over the game. It opens while its layer is active; a stick, the mouse or the radial menu commands point at a sector.
radial.name: Name
radial.no_layers: First add a layer that opens the menu (for example while a button is held).
radial.delay_hint: Show only after this long, so quick presses don't flash it.
radial.label: Label

picker.power_confirm: “{command}” runs every time this mapping fires, without asking again. Add it?
picker.break: Break (next press plays the next part)
picker.anti_recoil_hint: Pulls the right stick down a little for as long as the mapping is held, e.g. on RT. Set the strength in the action's amount.
picker.cursor_hint: Moves the cursor to a point of the main screen, or keeps it inside an area while held; set the position in the action.
picker.cursor_clip: Keep cursor in the middle area
picker.turn_hint: Turns in the game with mouse motion; the full-turn calibration is in Config settings → Turns.
picker.pad_touch_hint: Plays the gesture on the virtual controller's touchpad; set its length in the action.
picker.pad_shake_hint: Shakes the virtual controller's accelerometer (DualShock 4); strength and length are in Config settings.

macro.title: Macro for {control}
macro.empty: Add steps with the pickers below or record them from the keyboard.
macro.recording_pad: Recording — press buttons, sticks and triggers on the controller, then stop
macro.break_hint: the next press plays the part after this
macro.segments: {n} parts: each press plays the next one, then it starts over.

params.absolute_hint: Replace the physical stick on this axis instead of adding to it.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts on {layer}
shortcuts.hint: Click or press 2 to 4 controls, then confirm.
shortcuts.empty: No shortcuts on this layer. A shortcut fires when 2–4 controls are pressed together.

analog.hint: Sticks, triggers, gyro and mouse routes
analog.title: Analog settings
analog.all_layers: Applies on every layer of this config, unless a layer changes it.

virtual.title: Buttons and keys on this stick
virtual.hint: For mappings that push the virtual stick from a button or key.
virtual.initial_hint: Deflection the moment the button goes down.
virtual.max_hint: Largest deflection a held button reaches (a mapping's own deflection can be lower).
virtual.speed_hint: How fast the deflection grows while the button is held.
virtual.multiplier_hint: Scale speed and acceleration per axis.
virtual.preview: Deflection over the first two seconds of holding a button.
virtual.curve_hint: Shapes everything the virtual stick sends, also the passed-through stick.
virtual.jitter_hint: A small offset that keeps moving around the stick while this layer is active, also with the stick at rest. Use a hold layer to limit it, e.g. to aiming.
virtual.delay_hint: Each step moves the offset to the next point of the pattern after a random time in this range.

touchpad.split_hint: Each half has its own regions, tap and click (Trackpad controls); the whole-pad regions are off then.
touchpad.zones_hint_radial: Sectors around a centre region: four, or eight when a diagonal is mapped.
touchpad.zones_hint_grid: Nine cells; the corners count as diagonals when one is mapped, else for the nearer edge.
touchpad.centre_hint: Radius of the centre region, from the middle to the edge.
touchpad.click_required: Regions only while the touchpad is clicked
touchpad.gestures_hint: Taps, swipes and zoom are always recognised; map them from the touchpad menu on the controller drawing.

gyro.scope: Applies to the whole config, on every layer.

mode_hint.motion: Gyro directions and zones fire while the controller turns, by how fast.
mode_hint.tilt: The controller is a stick: directions and zones follow how far it is tilted from its centre, and gyro routes to a stick follow the tilt (45° = full). Reset tilt sets the centre.

gyro.steering_hint: Roll: like a steering wheel. Turn: like aiming left and right. Lean left/right always follows the roll.
gyro.space_hint: Player space turns around gravity, so aiming left and right works however you hold the controller.
gyro.initially_on: Gyro on when the config starts
gyro.initially_on_hint: Commands turn the gyro on and off while the config runs.
gyro.zones_hint_motion: Where the low, medium and high zones start, in degrees per second.
gyro.zones_hint_tilt: Where the low, medium and high zones start, in degrees from the centre.
gyro.calibration_hint: Removes the drift of {name}'s gyro. Applies to the controller, in every config, and at once.
gyro.calibration_moved: The controller moved; the old calibration stays. Lay it down and try again.
gyro.auto_calibration_hint: Keeps the drift away whenever the controller lies still; very slow turns can be taken for drift.

layer.follows: {layer} uses Main's settings here. Changing one gives {layer} its own value.

analog.live_hint: Move the stick to see it here.
analog.no_controller: Connect a controller to see its input here.

stick.deadzone_hint: The output stays at zero below this deflection. 0 passes the raw stick through, so the game applies its own deadzone.
stick.anti_deadzone_hint: Smallest output once the stick leaves the deadzone, to skip the game's own deadzone.
stick.direction_width_hint: Degrees on each side of an axis that count as that direction alone. 22.5° gives eight equal directions.
stick.diagonals_hint: With separate diagonals the stick points in one of eight directions, and the diagonals can be mapped on their own. Without, a diagonal presses both of its directions.
stick.direction_threshold_hint: Deflection at which the stick's directions (up, left, …) count as pressed for mappings; the low zone starts here.
stick.direction_threshold_elliptic: Horizontal and vertical differ — change them under “Zone thresholds” of one of this stick's zones.
stick.curve_hint: Drag a point to shape the curve. Double-click to add a point, double-click a point to remove it. On a selected point the arrow keys move it, Insert or + adds one after it and Delete removes it.

trigger.deadzone_hint: Pulls below this read as zero; the rest is rescaled.
trigger.press_threshold_hint: Pull at which mappings of {control} fire; the low zone starts here.
trigger.full_pull_hint: Pull that reads as fully pressed and fires mappings of {control}.
trigger.effect_hint: DualSense only. Positions are shares of the trigger's travel.

routes.title: Analog routes on {layer}
routes.intro: A route moves the mouse or a stick continuously, driven by a stick, the gyro, the mouse or the touchpad.
routes.empty: No routes on this layer yet.

presets.gyro_aim: Gyro → right stick while {control} is held

routes.inherited_hint: Routes of Main apply here unless this layer has its own route for the same source.

scale.stick>mouse: 1 = 1000 pixels per second at full deflection
scale.mouse>stick: 1 = full deflection at 2000 counts per second
scale.touchpad>mouse: 1 = 1000 pixels for a swipe across the touchpad
scale.touchpad>stick: The finger's distance from the touchpad centre is the deflection
scale.stick>flick: 1 = exact: you turn as far as the stick's angle changes

routes.curve_hint: 1 is linear; above 1 is finer near the centre and faster at the edge.
routes.outer_hint: Deflection that already counts as fully pushed; many sticks don't reach 100 % in every direction.
routes.snap_hint: Stick deflections smaller than this read as centred.
routes.noise_filter_hint: Mouse motion of fewer counts per tick is ignored.
routes.acceleration_hint: Held at 90 % or more, the cursor speeds up by this much per second, up to 4 ×.
routes.flick_threshold_hint: How far the stick must be pushed to flick; letting it back in re-arms.
routes.flick_hint: Push the stick to face that way, then turn with it. Set how many mouse counts make a full turn in Config settings → Turns.
routes.anti_deadzone_hint: Smallest stick output, to skip the game's own deadzone.
routes.decay_ms_hint: The stick returns to the centre after this long without mouse motion.
routes.trackball_friction_hint: After you lift the finger the cursor keeps gliding; 100% stops it at once.
routes.consume_stick: Keep the stick from also reaching the virtual controller
routes.consume_mouse: Keep the mouse from also moving the cursor
routes.pressing: Press a button on the controller or a key (Esc cancels)
routes.no_gyro: The connected controller has no gyro.

devices.pick: The controller the slots run on
devices.own_hint: This controller has slots of its own: its own config and virtual controller

settings.title: Controllers
settings.hint: Doppelpad uses the ticked devices and ignores the others completely (no input, no hiding). Groups play several controllers as one: one config, one set of slots.
settings.group_hint: Connect two controllers to group them. Keyboard and mouse always count for everyone.
settings.power_off_hint: Saves battery when you put the controller down. Pressing its home button turns it back on.

remap.running_auto: Running: {name}, chosen by Autodetect for the game in front
remap.paused_focus: Paused: the game is not in front

settings.title: Settings
settings.stay_live: Keep remapping active while this window is focused
settings.hook_buttons: Select controls by pressing them on the controller
settings.autostart: Start with Windows, in the tray
settings.log_file: Log file (attach it to bug reports)
settings.rewasd: When reWASD is running at start-up

osd.title: On-screen notifications
osd.hint: Short messages over games, also while this window is closed to the tray. They do not show while this window has focus.
osd.keep_layer: Keep it up while the layer is active

runtime.title: While remapping
runtime.auto_switch: Autodetect: switch to a game's config while the game is in front
runtime.auto_switch_hint: Uses the programs listed for each game. Only the shared slots switch; controllers with slots of their own keep their config.
runtime.prevent_sleep: Keep the PC awake while a mapping plays input
runtime.pause_unfocused: Pause while the config's game is not in front
runtime.pause_unfocused_hint: Applies to configs of a game (from its folder or with program names of their own).
runtime.keep_offline_pads: Keep the virtual controller when a controller with slots of its own disconnects
runtime.locked_hint: On the lock screen, Ctrl+Alt+Del and administrator prompts Doppelpad always pauses and lets go of everything.

http.title: Local API (HTTP)
http.hint: Stream decks and scripts switch remapping and slots, load configs and read the state: the same requests as the command-line tool, plus an event stream (docs/API.md).
http.lan: Reachable from the network too (then only with the token)
http.new_token: New token (the old one stops working)

dsu.title: Motion server (DSU)
dsu.hint: Emulators such as Cemu, Dolphin or Ryujinx read the controllers' buttons, sticks and gyro over the DSU (cemuhook) protocol. The first four controllers take slots 1–4.
dsu.lan: Reachable from the network too (otherwise this PC only)

lights.title: Controller lights

players.while_remapping: Slot number while remapping is on

lights.mic: Microphone LED shows whether remapping is on (DualSense)

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.hint: A live picture of the controller and a list of the active layer's mappings. Turn them on and off with a controller hotkey or a command in a mapping.
overlays.hide_after_hint: Seconds without input; 0 keeps it up.

hotkeys.title: Controller hotkeys
hotkeys.hint: Hold the buttons together on the controller in use. They work in every config, with remapping off and without this window. While a hotkey is held, its buttons do not reach the game.
hotkeys.press: Hold the buttons, then let go…
hotkeys.too_many: A hotkey has at most {n} buttons.

rewasd.title: reWASD is running
rewasd.body: reWASD keeps your controllers to itself, so Doppelpad cannot read them while it runs. Doppelpad can quit it for you:
rewasd.admin_hint: Windows asks for administrator permission to stop the service.
rewasd.restart_hint: reWASD starts again with Windows or when you open it.
rewasd.quit_done: reWASD was quit — Doppelpad can use your controllers now.
rewasd.declined: reWASD keeps running: the administrator prompt was declined.

notices.service-takeover: A running Doppelpad background service was stopped — this app now handles remapping.
notices.save_errors: The config has errors and was not saved

identify.title: Identify buttons: {name}
identify.intro: Doppelpad asks for each button, trigger and stick direction in turn; press the one it names. Let go of everything before you start. Skip what your controller does not have. The result applies to every controller of this model.
identify.gone: The controller is no longer connected.

overlays.no_mappings: Nothing is mapped on this layer.
